uncited: **Prefix-Sum Computation:** Perform an exclusive prefix sum (scan) on the Count Buffer to generate the Offset Buffer.
The offset for voxel $v$ is the sum of triangle counts for all voxels $u < v$.
**Exact Buffer Allocation:** Calculate the total number of vertices $V_{total} = \sum T_v \times 3$ (assuming 3 vertices per triangle).
**Triangle Generation:** For each voxel, using the case index $C$, interpolate vertex positions on the intersected edges.
